output.summary: A flowering shrub probably native to Malaysia, parts of Indonesia and the Philippines, although extensive cultivation obscures its exact native range. Its hoof-shaped, two-lobed leaves and fragrant white flowers are distinctive. It is used in culinary dishes in Odisha, though the plant part and preparation are unspecified.
